That experience has taught me to look at problems from more than one angle: what the data says, what makes sense for the business, and how the decision affects the people involved.

This portfolio brings that experience together with my MBA work in leadership, strategy, healthcare, finance, and analytics.

::: {.highlight-band}
<span class="eyebrow">How I Approach the Work</span>

## Start with what is actually happening.

I tend to ask a lot of questions before deciding what the answer should be. What does the data tell us? What are we missing? Who is closest to the problem? What is the organization rewarding? And does the proposed solution actually work for the people expected to use it?

The goal is not analysis for the sake of analysis. It is making a better decision.
:::
